$comment: Built-in booking event types. `key` is stored in bookings.event_type; `emoji` is the default bookings.event_icon; `label_key` resolves the localized display name from the string catalog; `color` is the type's DEFAULT calendar color — a key from booking-colors.json. Color resolution contract (both apps): explicit bookings.color if set → this event-type default → standard themed purple. The `custom` type additionally lets the user enter a free-text label and pick any emoji. Emoji are NOT localized.
